title: Boot Splash image does not resize if window resizes
body: ### Tested versions For Windows: - Reproducable in: v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] For macOS: - Reproducable in: v4.5.stable.official [876b29033] - Not reproducable in: v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] ### System information Tested both on Windows 10 and macOS 26.0.1 ### Issue description If the window gets resized during boot the boot splash image does not resize. It stays the size the window was originally. macOS: Windows: ### Steps to reproduce Here is a simple scripts that demonstrates the bug: ```ruby extends Node var initial = true var duration = 5.0 func _ready() -> void: get_window().size *= 2 func _process(_delta: float) -> void: if not initial: return var start_time = Time.get_unix_time_from_system() while Time.get_unix_time_from_system() - start_time < duration: pass initial = false ``` When this script is attached to the Main Scene node the boot splash issues arises. (The delay is only here to demonstrate the bug more easily, it is not necessary for the bug to arise) It is important to not embed the game window since that causes some unwanted behaviour. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [boot-splash-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22870203/boot-splash-bug.zip) It is important to not embed the game window since that causes some unwanted behaviour.
